Only a polyphonic cable reaches one memory at a time. snhTrigger.process() is called twice per frame on the same voltage (lines 103 and 203); the second call can never fire because the first has already taken the state high, so the duplicate block is dead. Mesohyl.notes: In OR mode an unpatched jack is not counted as a high vote: isUpdating() checks which of the two jacks are patched and uses only those, so one patched S&H jack rules the row on its own. In AND mode an unpatched jack does count as high, so a single patched jack also rules the row. The comment block at the head of the file lists an AND/OR mode, a range knob and a bipolar switch as things still to add; all three are present in the shipped build, and the un-updated-knob lights listed there are present too. The un-updated-count output listed in that comment was never built.

Mesoglea2.notes: The gate states are plain members rather than parameters, so unlike Mesoglea's they are not written into the patch file and every row comes up closed on load. The TOMUTE jacks and the OUTPUT jacks carry whatever is patched in and are given no family. The AND/OR logic is the same routine as Mesohyl's: in OR mode only the jacks that are actually patched get a vote, so one patched jack rules the row.
